assessment_metadata.title: PaySwift Gateway - Full Compliance Assessment
assessment_metadata.assessor_notes: Tier-1 Payment Processor due diligence. Vendor demonstrates industry-leading cybersecurity controls, hardware token MFA, and unexpired PCI-DSS Level 1 AoC.

answers.evidence: FIDO2 / WebAuthn hardware security keys mandatory for all staff accessing production billing infrastructure.
Zero Standing Privileges (ZSP) enforced via CyberArk PAM with just-in-time access and full session recording.
Cardholder data tokenized and encrypted with dedicated FIPS 140-3 Level 3 Hardware Security Modules (HSM). TLS 1.3 only.
Automated data lifecycle management adhering to PCI-DSS 3.1 sanitization and secure deletion verification.
Contractually committed 24-hour breach notification SLA; quarterly tabletop exercises with external incident response retainer (Mandiant).
Continuous Qualys scanning with 7-day critical patch SLA; bi-annual white-box penetration test by Bishop Fox.
PCI-DSS v4.0 Level 1 Service Provider AoC and SOC 2 Type II with zero testing exceptions reviewed.
Multi-region active-active architecture with 99.999% uptime SLA, tested RTO < 5 minutes, RPO = 0.
Formal C-SCRM program with continuous automated SBOM dependency scanning (Snyk) and contractual pass-through security requirements.
Rigorous background checks (financial & criminal) and monthly adaptive security awareness training for all engineers.
